options.name: label
options.description: Accessible name of the menubar (aria-label). Must be a non-empty string.

options.name: items
options.description: Non-empty list of menubar items { id, label, icon?, disabled?, items? }. Items with items open a Menu; items without are commands. Ids are unique across the bar and all of its menus.

options.name: renderItem
options.description: Custom item content (since 0.9.0); the label stays the accessible name and typeahead text. Nodes are reused per item and released with releaseNode when dropped.

options.name: icons
options.type: Partial<{ submenu: IconRef; checked: IconRef; radio: IconRef }>
options.description: Icon slot overrides passed to every menu.

options.name: closeOnSelect
options.description: Menus close after activating a checkbox or radio item. Action items always close the menu.

options.name: typeahead
options.description: Printable characters move focus to the next bar item (skipping disabled items) or menu item whose label starts with them.

options.name: direction
options.description: Arrow-key mirroring and menu/submenu sides. An inherited dir=rtl on the host also makes the bar RTL.

properties.name: host
properties.description: The host element (class aui-menu-bar); its children are replaced.

properties.name: element
properties.description: The role=menubar element inside the host.

methods.name: menu
methods.description: The Menu opened by a menubar item, or null for commands, disabled items, and unknown ids.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close any open menu; focus returns to its menubar item when it was inside the menu.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge, validate, and re-render. Focus and the tab stop stay on the same item id; open menus close and menu state resets. A failed update keeps the previous options.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroy every menu, remove listeners and subscriptions, empty the host, and remove the aui-menu-bar class.

events.name: aui-select
events.detail: { id: string; item: MenuBarItem | MenuSelectableItem; checked?: boolean }
events.description: A command bar item or an enabled menu item was activated. Always dispatched on the host (menu selections are re-dispatched there). checked is the new state for checkbox and radio items.

cssClasses.name: aui-menu-bar--rtl
cssClasses.description: Set on the host when the effective direction is RTL.

cssClasses.name: aui-menu-bar__entry
cssClasses.description: role=none wrapper (display: contents) around each item and its menu popup.

cssClasses.name: aui-menu-bar__item
cssClasses.description: Bar item button (role=menuitem); [aria-expanded='true'] while its menu is open.

cssClasses.name: aui-menu (and all aui-menu__* classes)
cssClasses.description: Menu popups opened from the bar; styled by @absoluteui/components/menu/style.css.
